In these studies, when examining the timing of when disruption phenotypes became apparent:
- Gene loci disruptions tend to show more immediate phenotypic effects
- Regulatory elements (enhancers, conserved regions) tend to show delayed or less penetrant effects

After 4 cell divisions, approximately 61% of gene loci disruptions showed apparent phenotypes, reflecting the relatively direct and rapid impact of disrupting coding sequences on cellular function.
